# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata" "example_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  data = {

  }
  import_path = "x"
  name = "x"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `data` (String)
- `import_path` (String) Unique Rego import path in the form metadata.<segment>, with one alphanumeric or underscore segment. Reference it as data.<import_path>.
- `name` (String) Name of the rego metadata document (unique per account)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_metadata.example '<account_id>/<rego_metadata_id>'
```
